title: Danawa price-comparison service suspended after suspected external intrusion, Connectwave notice says
date_note: Boannews (26 November) says service was halted on 26 November; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: country; the article gives no city
summary: Boannews reports that Danawa, the price-comparison platform run by Connectwave, suspended service on 26 November after a security incident. Connectwave's notice says it suspended service to protect user information, is investigating cause and scope and is checking whether personal information leaked. It says it reported to the authorities, will bring in an external security organisation and will resume service in stages; no schedule is given.
plain: Danawa, a Korean price-comparison site, suspended service after a security incident. Its operator Connectwave says it is checking whether personal data leaked and will resume service in stages.
exec: Danawa's operator Connectwave says it suspended service after a security incident and has not yet said whether personal data leaked or when service returns.
action: Connectwave says it will announce any confirmed leak without delay and notify customers individually; watch for that notice.
impact: Danawa service suspended; Connectwave says leak of personal information is being checked.

sources.name: Boannews: 가격 비교 플랫폼 ‘다나와’ 해킹 추정 사고... 서비스 일시 중단

validation.note: Boannews only, quoting Connectwave's notice; the notice itself was not read; a search found no second report.
